categories.main_business_segments: Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. operates primarily as a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on owning, operating, and developing Class A/A+ properties for the life science, agtech, and technology industries. Its business is organized by geographic clusters in major innovation markets, including Greater Boston, San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Seattle, Maryland, Research Triangle, New York City, Texas, and Canada. The company also has a venture capital platform investing in life science companies and holds non-real estate investments in public and private entities aligned with its core tenant base.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: ARE specializes in the development and management of high-specification laboratory and office spaces, known as Megacampus™ ecosystems, designed for life science and technology tenants. Properties feature advanced infrastructure such as reinforced concrete floors, heavy-duty HVAC, upgraded utilities, and flexible, generic laboratory buildouts to accommodate a wide range of scientific uses. The company emphasizes sustainability, energy efficiency, and resilience in design and construction, including LEED certifications and climate adaptation features.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are multinational pharmaceutical companies, public and private biotechnology firms, medical device and life science product/service companies, digital health and agtech companies, academic and medical research institutions, government research agencies, non-profits, and venture capital firms. Major end markets include the life sciences, healthcare, biotechnology, agtech, and technology sectors, with a focus on organizations engaged in research, development, and innovation.
categories.geographic_coverage: ARE operates in key North American innovation clusters: Greater Boston, San Francisco Bay Area, San Diego, Seattle, Maryland, Research Triangle, New York City, Texas, and Canada. As of December 31, 2024, the company owned or managed 391 properties totaling 44.1 million rentable square feet, with the majority of its portfolio concentrated in the U.S. coastal and major research markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Alexandria operates as a downstream player in the real estate supply chain, providing specialized, high-quality laboratory and office space to end users in the life sciences and technology sectors. The company does not manufacture products but enables R&D, innovation, and business operations for its tenants through real estate assets and related services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, ARE focuses on expanding and enhancing its Megacampus ecosystems in AAA innovation clusters, maintaining high occupancy and tenant quality, and supporting tenant growth through scalable real estate solutions. The company invests in sustainable development, climate resilience, and energy efficiency, and leverages its venture capital platform to foster innovation in the life sciences. R&D initiatives are centered on property design, construction methods, and amenities that support cutting-edge scientific work and talent attraction.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through rental income from long-term leases (mostly triple net) with annual escalations, tenant recoveries for operating expenses and capital expenditures, and development fees. Additional revenue streams include gains from property sales, joint venture income, and returns from non-real estate venture investments. The lease structure emphasizes stability, with 92% of leases being triple net and 97% containing annual escalations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ARE competes with other REITs, institutional investors, private equity, developers, and owners of laboratory and technology properties, many of which have significant financial resources. Despite strong competition, Alexandria is positioned as the preeminent and longest-tenured owner, operator, and developer of collaborative life science real estate in top innovation clusters, with a reputation for high-quality assets, strong tenant relationships, and operational excellence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, ARE had a total market capitalization of $29.0 billion and an asset base of 44.1 million RSF in North America. Total revenues for 2024 were $3.1 billion, up 8% year-over-year, with net operating income (cash basis) of $2.0 billion. The company maintains high occupancy (94.6%), strong tenant collections (99.9%), and a robust development pipeline, though it faces headwinds from rising interest rates, increased supply, and macroeconomic uncertainty. Funds from operations (FFO) per share, as adjusted, was $9.47 in 2024, with projected 2025 FFO per share guidance of $9.23–$9.43.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Alexandria differentiates itself through its focus on Class A/A+ laboratory and office properties in premier innovation clusters, offering tenants scalable, flexible, and highly amenitized Megacampus environments that foster collaboration, talent attraction, and productivity. The company emphasizes operational excellence, sustainability, and resilience, and maintains a high-quality, diverse tenant base with long lease terms and strong credit. Its integrated approach, combining real estate, venture investment, and industry relationships, delivers unique value to life science and technology organizations seeking best-in-class facilities.
